name: TED (Tenders Electronic Daily)
summary: EU public procurement notices published in the Official Journal supplement (OJ S): tenders, awards and other notices from across the EU and EEA, via the TED Search API.
notes: Keyless: the Search API needs no authentication (submitting notices does, and is not in this entry).
Queries use TED's expert search syntax; build and check one on ted.europa.eu's Expert Search page, or send checkQuerySyntax=true.
fields is required: name the notice fields to return (e.g. publication-number, notice-title, buyer-name, publication-date); links to XML/PDF/HTML come back too.
Limits: 250 notices per page, 10,000 fields per page (notices x fields), and 15,000 notices per query in PAGE_NUMBER mode; ITERATION mode has no total cap.
Text fields are keyed by language code (e.g. buyer-name.lav), since notices are multilingual.

endpoints.name: Search procurement notices
endpoints.summary: Notices matching an expert query, with the requested fields, total count and an iteration token.

fields.description: Notice fields to return for each notice.

limit.description: Notices per page; default 10, at most 250.

scope.description: LATEST current OJ S issue, ACTIVE active notices, ALL (default).

paginationMode.description: PAGE_NUMBER (default, up to 15,000 notices) or ITERATION (scroll, no cap).

iterationNextToken.description: Token from the previous response, for the next page in ITERATION mode; omit on the first call.

onlyLatestVersions.description: Only the latest version of each notice; default false.

checkQuerySyntax.description: true checks the query syntax without running it.

notes: In ITERATION mode the snapshot holds until the next OJ S release plus 24 hours; an empty page means all notices are retrieved.
